instructions: Solve the assigned coding exercise. No tools are available.

input.text: Inputs are arbitrary integers. Return bool indicating that a fits in an unsigned field of width b, where b must be 1..16. Output Python source defining f(a, b), with optional int/bool annotations and no defaults. A single enclosing ```python fence is accepted but unnecessary. Allowed: integer/bool literals, local assignments, if/else, return, comparisons, and/or/not, + - * // % & | ^ ~ << >>. No imports, calls, loops or other syntax. All intermediate integers must fit signed 128 bits; shift counts must be 0..63.
